subject.title: [Bug]: room_event forces message_tool_only despite visibleReplies=automatic, destabilizing prompt cache

question: Should ambient `room_event` runs keep strict `message_tool_only` effective delivery while using a session-stable prompt-facing delivery mode and safe room-event owner-only tool inventory for cache reuse?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the remaining fix changes a prompt/tool policy boundary and ambient room-event capability shape rather than being a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept linked PR policy
options.body: Land the linked candidate if maintainers agree that prompt-facing cache stability may diverge from effective delivery without widening explicit non-owner execution access.

options.title: Revise tool-inventory policy
options.body: Require the linked PR to preserve owner-sent room-event owner-only tool visibility and accept a narrower or separately proven cache fix.

options.title: Document strict behavior only
options.body: Reject the runtime change and document the prompt-cache tradeoff as part of the strict ambient-room contract.

recommendation.title: Accept linked PR policy
recommendation.body: Land the linked candidate if maintainers agree that prompt-facing cache stability may diverge from effective delivery without widening explicit non-owner execution access.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the visible-reply and ambient-room policy history from the merged visible-reply work.
